title: Article
description: A reading page: the section's progress, the text at 42rem with the previous and next page at its end, and the table of contents beside it on a wide screen (above it on a narrow one). An article adds its date, tags and related articles.

title.description: The article's heading, its title in listings and in search results

description.description: One sentence under the heading, its teaser in listings, and its description for search results

page.description: What the storefront works out for the page

date.description: The article's date, from its frontmatter

tags.description: The article's tags, from its frontmatter

related.description: Up to three articles of the same folder, the ones sharing most tags and categories first, in the compact view. An article changes options under related: (limit: 5, indented), or turns them off with related: false

prev.description: The page before this one in the navigation

next.description: The page after this one in the navigation

regions.description: The layout's regions: the sidebar, with the table of contents first, empty when the page has neither
